name: web-social-network-icon-web-illustration-colourful-connected-figures
title: Social media integration illustration: colourful platform icons connected in a web above small standing figures
whatItIs: A vector illustration on a light background with colourful circular platform and function icons (phone, email, video, Facebook, chat, megaphone) connected by thin blue lines and dot nodes in a web pattern, with small silhouetted and flat-coloured human figures standing beneath as if part of the network.
whatItMeans: Comprehensive and reassuring; a fully connected network visualises 'integrated marketing' as one single, orderly system.
techniques: Connect many small icons with thin lines into one network shape.
Mix flat colour and silhouette figures for depth without extra detail.
Use consistent circular containers for every icon regardless of type.

vocabulary.definition: Nodes connected by lines to show relationships or systems.
A consistent shape (like a circle) holding each icon.
